name: iron vambraces
_design_note: F20-60 medium arms slot. Riveted plate from wrist to elbow. Covers iron_bracers, bronze_bracers, chain_bracers, scale_bracers from legacy data — material is the variation axis.
lore_template: Vambraces of riveted {material_name}, encasing the forearm from wrist to elbow in a single curved plate. Soldiers wear these when they expect to block weapon strikes with their arms — a maneuver discouraged in drill, but sometimes unavoidable in the close quarters where shield discipline breaks down.
